verdict.rationale: Gemini's own Privacy Hub says users can export their information and links that export to Google Takeout, so a first-party export path is documented. The evidence does not say what the export contains, so it is unproven that it covers complete chat history plus account data. Reviewing or deleting activity in My Activity is a separate control and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the export includes full Gemini chat history and account data, a description of export format and scope, and hands-on or independent confirmation that the export works.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can export my complete chat history and account data

citations.quote: You can also export your information.
